Balance owed per matter and unbilled hours match the export to the cent.
Trust balances are reported exactly and never written to Clio by software.

A batch that does not tie to the old system's report is held, never loaded.
Nothing waiting in the review queue is written to Clio.
Every request in the load plan is valid against Clio's published v4 API schema, with no unknown field names.
Each client is the right type (person or company) and a person's name is split correctly.
Each unfamiliar column goes to the right Clio field.
Every record in the review queue carries a reason.

Each review-queue reason tells the firm's operations lead, in plain words, exactly which record to look at and what answer is needed (for example which of two clients a matter belongs to, or whether two rows are the same person).
